claim: Highlights names, speaker labels, sound cues, and saved words.
where: catalog, landing page, demo, extension popup, README
sandbox: fresh demo context; assert each sample fragment has its intended visible treatment

claim: Demo changes use a separate namespace and do not change ordinary site or extension data.
where: demo banner, privacy page, demo documentation
sandbox: fresh ?demo=1&license=review-token context with sentinel ordinary keys; assert the banner, no license write, reset, and unchanged sentinels

claim: The demo works offline after one visit.
sandbox: fresh context; prime /demo/, wait for service worker, go offline, reload, and change caption line

claim: Caption controls need no account, and all highlighting and replay tools are free.
sandbox: fresh demo context without credentials or license; exercise every caption and replay control

claim: Alt+R and the replay control replay the last caption line.
where: landing preview, how-it-works section, demo, extension popup, README
sandbox: fresh demo plus two fresh packaged-extension profiles; assert demo replay, Alt+R seeks a browser TextTrack to its cue start, and the real popup reshows the exact page-caption line in a polite live status

claim: Supports standard browser caption tracks and caption text the page makes available.
where: landing compatibility section, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh extension profile; load local page caption text and browser caption-track fixtures; assert both are visibly enhanced

claim: Captions baked into the video picture or not provided as page text stay unchanged, and the popup shows a waiting state.
where: landing limitation, demo compatibility check, README
sandbox: fresh extension profile; load a caption surface the page does not provide as text; assert exact unchanged content and the popup waiting status

claim: Caption Cues does not capture audio, download video, create a transcript, or bypass protected players.
sandbox: fresh extension profile and local fixture; intercept the complete caption and replay flow; assert no media or transcript request

claim: Caption text and settings stay in the browser.
where: landing FAQ, privacy page, extension popup, README
sandbox: fresh extension profile; save settings; inspect extension storage and request URLs for caption payloads

claim: Disabling Caption Cues restores the page's original caption state.
sandbox: fresh extension profile; enhance DOM and TextTrack fixtures, disable through storage, assert original text and track mode

claim: The build produces legal and demo pages, a Manifest V3 extension, and a Chrome ZIP.
sandbox: clean build; assert every documented artifact exists and the ZIP is non-empty

claim: The release worker versions its offline shell, serves pages network-first, and serves build assets cache-first.
sandbox: clean build; inspect generated worker for release hash, both strategies, and demo shell entry

claim: The extension uses only page access, storage, and activeTab for captions, settings, status, and replay.
sandbox: clean build; inspect packaged manifest and assert exact permissions and host patterns

claim: The site and extension use no analytics, remote fonts, code loaded from other sites, or extension network calls.
sandbox: fresh demo context plus packaged manifest; intercept requests and inspect all script, stylesheet, preload, and host entries

claim: The original proof-sheet artwork was generated with the factory image model.
sandbox: clean checkout; compare source SHA-256 with provenance metadata and assert the derived social image ships
